source: AglaSem Docs copy of the NTA master question paper (CUET UG 2026 Question Paper Computer Science Information Practices, 68 PDF pages: a cover plus 67 numbered pages), https://docs.aglasem.com/view/6b6deefe-c701-11f1-b09d-0aa932765c8b, PDF https://cdn.aglasem.com/aglasem-doc/6b6deefe-c701-11f1-b09d-0aa932765c8b/6b6deefe-c701-11f1-b09d-0aa932765c8b.pdf (14,559,947 bytes, ETag d2ff65f9739ab26a5f9d6284d303cee3, Last-Modified 13 Oct 2026), downloaded 23 Nov 2026 under the owner's 23 Nov 2026 request to download the papers for the remaining subjects. English text transcribed from the page images (OCR used only for ids and as a draft). Answers from NTA's CUET (UG) 2026 final answer key (option ids), subject 308.

provenance.finalKey: cuet-2026-final-keys.pdf (NTA CUET (UG) 2026 final answer key), subject 308, 13 shifts x 85 rows; rows extracted to tmp/1123-papers/computer-science/work/keys-computer-science.json

structure: Group 3 'Computer Science and Informatics Practices' (60 minutes, group marks 250), numbered 101 to 185 and printed in English then Hindi: Section A Common (mandatory, 15 questions, 101-115, 75 marks), Section B1: Computer Science (optional, 35 questions, 116-150, 175 marks) and Section B2: Informatics Practices (optional, 35 questions, 151-185, 175 marks). A candidate answers Section A and one of B1 or B2 (50 questions). All 85 are single-answer MCQs with four options; no comprehension passages.
authentication: A question is authenticated when its printed NTA question id is in the 24-05-2026 (First) final key for subject 308 and the key option id is one of its four printed option ids. Printed option ids are consecutive per question.
notes: Each question is printed in English, then Hindi; only the English is transcribed, read from the page images. Spelling and wording kept as printed (e.g. Q106 'Which Sql Statements correctly retrieves', Q110 'The Berners – Lee' and 'or –mail symbol@', Q145 'measurment', Q149 option 4 'It does not spreads', Q162 'Order the following steps to for creation', Q184 'phising' and 'aquaintance', Q146 'Ghz' and 'Thz').

Page = the PDF page (pNN of the 68-page PDF; the printed footer 'Page N of 67' is one lower) where the question's header line was read; for most questions the English body starts at the top of the next page.

Tables (Q105 STUDENT, Q138 relation, Q141 Sales) and match lists are written as rows with ' | ' between cells, in the order the paper prints them. Q147's list and pass outputs are printed as boxed cells; they are written with ' | ' between cells (read at higher zoom: 8 7 13 1 -9 4; (A) 7 8 1 -9 4 13; (B) 7 1 -9 4 8 13; (C) -9 1 4 7 8 13; (D) 1 -9 4 7 8 13).
Q132 options 1 and 4 print superscripts (n squared, n cubed); written as 'n^2' and 'n^3'.
Q121: the six operations are printed as a numbered list 1 to 6 inside the stem, then the values (A) to (D); kept as printed.

Q105, Q118, Q142, Q177: OCR missed the English header line, so their question ids and option ids were read from the page images (pp. 6, 17, 37, 62) and each matches its Hindi copy; they then authenticated like the rest.

The paper has three sections: A Common (101-115, mandatory), B1 Computer Science (116-150) and B2 Informatics Practices (151-185); a candidate takes A plus one of B1 or B2. All 85 are transcribed and authenticated. Which sections MockMob's computer_science bank should be judged against is for the coverage stage to decide (B2 is the Informatics Practices syllabus: pandas, matplotlib, SQL functions, societal impacts, project-based learning).

Every key was read against the question as transcribed and fits it (e.g. Q124 queue ends 30, 40, 50, 60 so (A), (B), (D); Q134 population standard deviation of the seven readings is 3.2; Q146 NCERT gives radio waves 3 KHz to 1 GHz; Q147 bubble-sort passes are (A), (B), (D), (C)).

Keys to flag for the coverage stage (published key kept, not changed): Q166 keys 'GROUP BY()' for the pandas function that splits data into groups (pandas spells it groupby()); Q156 keys '(B) and (D) only' (statement (A) is half right); Q158 keys 'Defining a plan' for identifying a project leader; Q178 keys '(A) and (C) only' for project specifications; Q181's etiquette match follows NCERT IP's net-etiquette headings. These follow NCERT Informatics Practices wording and are kept as NTA published them.

The shift's key has 85 rows, all single-answer, none dropped. NTA's final key for subject 308 holds 13 shifts of 85 rows (two multiple-answer rows in other shifts); this paper is the 24-05-2026 First shift and all 85 question ids fall in that one shift.
OCR slips fixed: none needed in the final text, because the text was typed from the page images, not cleaned from OCR (the OCR draft ran words together and was used only for ids).

questions.stem: Which Sql Statements correctly retrieves records from a 'Commodity' table where the Price is either above 1000 or the product Category is 'Sales'?
options: SELECT * FROM Commodity WHERE Price>1000 OR Category ='Sales';

questions.stem: Which query correctly finds a category in the 'Commodity' table that has more than 5 products with a Price greater than 600?
options: SELECT category FROM Commodity GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*)>5 AND Price >600;

SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM Commodity GROUP BY Category HAVING Price>600 AND COUNT(*)>5;
